answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable bond that vests only after a probationary history of attested useful work, like a comet that must be tracked across many orbits before it is trusted. A new identity starts as a faint pigment of reputation and earns color only through verifiable service, while a sybil farmer who splits one bond across many fake identities dilutes each one below the threshold where any single sonnet of work can unlock rewards. Forging a thousand identities then costs a thousand bonds, not one.
